long_biography.plain_text:
At its peak, Theo’s Liquor had 80 stores and ranked as Australia’s fourth-largest liquor retailer. Theo Karedis built that scale from a small convenience business, broadening through supermarkets before concentrating on bottle shops. The 2002 sale to Coles converted decades of retail expansion into the capital for a new investment phase.

Karedis co-founded Arkadia with his son Greg, transferring lessons in service, purchasing and logistics into property ownership. The group assembled large-format retail centres along Australia’s eastern seaboard and expanded into hotels, hospitality and investment management. His working style remained visible in the business: industry peers remembered a disciplined negotiator who dealt firmly, valued family and gave emerging suppliers a chance.
